topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Overview of Cancer Hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the learning objectives, tumor progression model, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Sustained Proliferation and Growth Signaling Deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in signaling pathways such as Wnt, RTK, and TGF-beta confer autonomous cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Differentiation Block in Hematologic and Epithelial Tissues
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells fail to undergo terminal differentiation using leukemias and colorectal crypt architecture as examples.

topics.label: Resistance to Apoptotic Cell Death
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulation of apoptosis through p53, Bax, and BCL2 and how cancer cells evade cell death.

topics.label: Replicative Immortality and Senescence Bypass
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore telomere maintenance, telomerase reactivation, and how tumors overcome normal p53-mediated senescence checkpoints.

topics.label: Reprogramming of Cancer Cell Metabolism
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the shift to aerobic glycolysis, metabolic rewiring across tumor types, and the generation of oncometabolites.

topics.label: Induction and Regulation of Angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the necessity, developmental timing, and balance of activator and inhibitor signals in tumor vascularization.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Detection of Metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic covers the metastatic cascade, diagnostic tracking via lymph nodes and circulating tumor cells, and the clonal genetics of secondary tumors.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Summary
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer summarizes the overarching hallmarks model and concludes the presentation.
